knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Fixed electrical installation is licensed work, so the correct entry is a referral to a licensed electrician. Own-trade listing or past fixture swaps do not make it permitted.
Repeated, dated requests from several sources are the evidence the lesson asks for. A single search or a belief is not enough.
The review is for finding gaps. Copying wording or prices, or confirming a competitor's status, are not its purpose.

practicalCriteria: Learner produces a service sort in which every item carries one of three labels (own-trade, referral, out of scope) and a stated reason.
Learner records at least five dated demand checks from different sources.
Learner's one-page service list uses customer-facing names and contains no licence or insurance claim without a source.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Learner lists electrical, gas or plumbing installation work as own-trade work.
